title: Update 12 re-test: playtest fixes, trap decay, breaches, ghosts that follow you home

steps.title: Quiet traps
lines: Two full traps sit on the platform. Stay near them for a minute: at most a soft rattle now and then.
Pick one up (sneak + empty hand): it should stay silent in your inventory while it's healthy. Check its tooltip and bar.

steps.title: Creeper warning chirp
lines: A frozen creeper waits round the corner behind you. Listen to the wisp:
it should be the same wisp chirp as for a zombie, only higher and doubled, with the subtitle "Wisp warns urgently".

steps.title: Wisp guide over hills and trees
lines: You're 64 blocks from a real cabin, facing away, with your wisp. Sneak + use the vessel and follow it.
It should fly over trees and hills, wait for you at each stop, and circle the cabin when you're close.

steps.title: Ward edge preview
lines: A Ward Lantern stands in the middle (radius 12 for this step; the next steps put 32 back). Hold the other lantern and walk toward the edge.
Is the edge a clear line of cyan motes, with a short post every 4 blocks?
setup: item replace entity @s weapon.mainhand with paranormalcraft:ward_lantern

steps.title: Ward flare
lines: A ghost inside the ward tries to haunt. Watch and listen:
the lantern pulses bright, a ring bursts out, a chime ("Ward repels a spirit"), and the ghost flashes into view as it's pushed back.

steps.title: Blessings and Bindings, and the unit's tooltips
lines: Find the Blessings and Bindings spread in the journal: does it say what Restful and the Wisp Familiar do?
Then close it, open the Containment Unit, select a spirit, and hover Release and Bind.

steps.title: Trap decay to escape
lines: You're looking at a trap set to 2%. Hear the urgent rattles (and EMF 4 nearby); in about 25 s it bursts open.
The ghost comes out Agitated (a faint red tint with goggles on) and starts following you.

steps.title: A breach, and stopping it
lines: The unit is out of charge and breaching: a fast alarm, cracking glass, and a spirit escapes every 30 s.
Take soul sand from the chest beside it and put it in the fuel slot: the breach should stop.

steps.title: A ghost follows you home
lines: The ghost beside you is following you now ("You feel watched"). Walk to the hut in the far corner; it settles in.
Then ward the hut with a lantern (no more haunting), and catch it with the wand and a trap for House Call.
